Naturalism holds that reality is entirely natural and is best understood through the sciences, including the theoretical entities those sciences posit. Positivism holds that a claim counts as knowledge only when it rests on observation and empirical verification. The major difference is that naturalism commits you to a natural world investigated by science, while positivism sets a stricter limit on which statements count as knowledge. The claim that naturalism is mainly non-European and that positivism was developed only by European jurists is false.
